findings.claim: T133-K0-RES through T133-KLEVEL are clean no-send formal release-consistency checks with adversarial_review_blocker_total=0.
findings.failure_mode: Each ledger row cites a proof sheet as evidence, but every current T133 proof sheet is marked Status: BLOCKED_PENDING_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_V12 and states it is not release-promoted while G57/G58/G70 remain open. The ledger imports those blocked candidate theorem sheets as FORMAL_RELEASE_CONSISTENCY_CHECK support while reporting adversarial_review_blocker_total=0. This is theorem theater even though public scientific promotion remains false.
findings.required_repair: Regenerate the claim ledger from the current proof-sheet statuses: mark affected T133 rows blocked, set nonzero blocker totals, and exclude them from clean support totals until fresh Cerberus/G57/G58/G70 closure passes; or replace the proof sheets with passed repair-reviewed evidence and then update the ledger counters in the same release pass.
